# A dependency's generator runs on this machine, so it is built as an APE.
# A build that targets another platform still gets the package generated,
# rather than a generator the host cannot execute.

env GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
[GOOS:windows] env GOOS=linux
[!GOOS:windows] env GOOS=windows

go mod download example.com/generated
exists $GOPATH/pkg/mod/example.com/generated@v1.0.0/lang/lang.gen.go

go build ./...
! stderr 'exec format error'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/consumer

go 1.16

require example.com/generated v1.0.0
-- use.go --
package use

import "example.com/generated/lang"

var Name = lang.Name()
